I'm planning JUnit 4 tests for AtomicReferenceDeserializer, considering its constructor dependencies like JavaType, ValueInstantiator, TypeDeserializer, and JsonDeserializer, and thinking through how to construct real instances for these.

Since this is Defects4J JacksonDatabind-111b, the actual jackson-databind source will already be compiled and available on the classpath during the test build, so I don't need separate jars for those classes. For the trickier dependencies like ValueInstantiator, TypeDeserializer, and DeserializationContext, I can just use Mockito mocks since that's available, while building the JavaType itself through TypeFactory.

Now I'm sketching out the test cases: one to verify getNullValue produces a fresh AtomicReference wrapping null, another to verify getEmptyValue behaves the same way, and a third to check behavior when the reference has non-null contents.

I'm also planning tests for the null case, for getReferenced returning the wrapped value (or null when empty), and for updateReference—confirming it mutates the existing reference in place and returns the same instance.

I also want to verify supportsUpdate always returns Boolean.TRUE regardless of the config passed (including null), and that withResolved produces a new AtomicReferenceDeserializer instance with updated deserializers rather than mutating the original.

I should also test constructing the deserializer with null type/value deserializers to confirm it doesn't throw, covering those nullable edge cases from Jackson's design.

Now I'm setting up the imports I'll need: AtomicReferenceDeserializer, JavaType, TypeFactory, ValueInstantiator, and the various Jackson deserialization context classes, plus Mockito and JUnit essentials. I'm using TypeFactory to construct the JavaType for AtomicReference, watching for whether that call might throw.

I'm planning to mock the ValueInstantiator, TypeDeserializer, JsonDeserializer, DeserializationContext, and DeserializationConfig with Mockito, and set up a fresh deserializer instance for each test in a setUp method. I also want to add tests verifying that withResolved handles null typeDeserializer/valueDeserializer gracefully and returns a new instance without exceptions. Now I'm drafting the full test class.
